title: fix: show regular traffic across usage dashboards
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Follow-up to #15399. Usage dashboards show regular traffic only; legacy, operations and dev are separated and no dashboard has a traffic selector. Dedicated dashboards for the other groups can come later.

| Area | Before | Now | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Classification | 16 hand-picked key IDs | pollinationsagent keys by ID: 2 legacy, 9 operations, 2 dev; unlisted keys there (app keys, x402 buyers) stay regular. Elliot's and Thomas's accounts are dev | The agent account mixes groups, so it needs IDs; IDs survive owner changes. The old list missed the Discord bots, polli-harness-pi and the community model proxy |
| KPI cash coverage | Stripe sales / regular cost | Stripe sales / all-traffic cost (new `weekly_traffic_totals` pipe) | Cash is company-wide; regular-only cost was ~17% low (week of Sep 22: $4,525 vs $5,292) |
| KPI legacy | Not shown | Legacy row: requests, share, cost | Only place legacy stays visible (59% of requests, free for callers) |
| BYOM owner rewards | Regular only | Regular + operations | Rewards are payouts; the probe pays real owners. Staff testing excluded |
| Model Monitor | Regular, unstated | Intro says so | Probe-only models show "No traffic" |

- `/models/status` gains `traffic=all|regular`, default `all`, so existing consumers are unchanged.
- Rebuilds `generation_usage_hourly`, `byop_app_daily` and `user_first_activity_mv`. Quest payouts and Economics are unchanged.
- Production rollout paused: promote Tinybird, then merge the promotion PR right away; dashboards are blank in between.

gist.headline: Count the right bees
gist.blurb: The usage dashboards get a clearer view of regular traffic, while the KPI keeps the whole hive in its cost calculation. Legacy traffic gets its own row instead of quietly disappearing.
gist.summary: Usage dashboards separate regular traffic from legacy, operations, and dev traffic; KPI cash coverage uses all-traffic cost and shows a legacy row, while `/models/status` adds `traffic=all|regular` with `all` as the default.
gist.impact: Dashboard readers get regular-traffic figures without a selector, KPI readers can see legacy requests and company-wide costs, and API consumers can request regular-only model status without changing existing calls.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden observatory represents the dashboards: Polli sorts differently colored traffic seeds into labeled regular, legacy, operations, and dev pots, while a friendly CRT robot displays a whole-garden cost tally. Make the regular pot prominent, with the legacy pot still visible.
